records.issue_text: [High/data] src/sentry/spans/buffer.py:197 — Switching from SADD to ZADD without changing Redis key names causes WRONGTYPE errors for existing set buffers and prevents ZSCAN from flushing them; version the keys or migrate the data.
records.rationale: The diff shows that in buffer.py line 197, the code changes from using Redis SET operations (sadd) to sorted set operations (zadd), and in line 434, from sscan to zscan. The key namespace 'span-buf:s:{project_and_trace}:{parent_span_id}' remains the same. During a rolling deployment, old workers would still use sadd/sscan expecting SET type, while new workers use zadd/zscan expecting ZSET type. Redis will return WRONGTYPE error when a command is used on a key of the wrong type. There is no migration logic, version detection, or transition handling visible in the diff. records.issue_text: [Medium/data] src/sentry/scripts/spans/add-buffer.lua:48 — ZUNIONSTORE sums scores for replayed spans present in both buffers, inflating their timestamps and retaining them ahead of newer spans during eviction; use AGGREGATE MAX.
records.rationale: The finding identifies a real issue in the Lua script.
